description: Kandev sandbox hosts: the msbctl kandev verbs the Kandev plugin drives over ssh through host serve --kandev, one JSON document per verb with KandevError codes and exit 3, source = "kandev" registry entries with kandev_name() and kandev_lookup() and the k- prefix rule, kandev_provision() instead of do_create() with no bootstrap, mounts, vsock, profile or tokens, secrets on stdin only and never in argv, registry pull through a throwaway MSB_CONFIG_PATH with password_env, pinning the API by address and rewriting the guest /etc/hosts on every start, the port pool under kandev_lock(), and kandev reap. Use when changing any Kandev verb, its provisioning, its pinning or its teardown.
